attachments.origin_landmark: posterior tibia, interosseous membrane, posterior fibula
attachments.insertion_landmark: navicular tuberosity, with additional slips to the cuneiforms, cuboid, and bases of metatarsals 2-4

actions: plantarflexes and inverts the ankle, the primary dynamic support of the medial longitudinal arch

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Largest PCSA of any deep posterior compartment muscle; its multi-slip insertion fanning across most of the midfoot makes it the single most important dynamic stabilizer of the medial arch -- its dysfunction is the leading cause of acquired adult flatfoot deformity.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Proximal of two zones (Lee et al., as cited in the review).
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Distal of two zones (Lee et al.). A separate mapping by Yi et al. places a zone at 70-80% along the lateral malleolus to fibular head line, which is a different reference line running the opposite way -- the two are not directly comparable and are reported here as the review reports them.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
